headline.title: SoftBank is creating a robotics company that builds data centers — and already eyeing a $100B IPO
headline.summary: SoftBank is launching a robotics company focused on constructing data centers, leveraging AI and robotics technology for infrastructure development. The company is reportedly targeting a $100 billion initial public offering (IPO).

articles.title: Sources: Anthropic could raise a new $50B round at a valuation of $900B
articles.summary: Anthropic, the developer of the AI model Claude, is reportedly considering a new funding round that could raise $50 billion, with valuations ranging from $850 billion to $900 billion. Multiple pre-emptive offers have been made to the company, according to sources.

articles.title: Microsoft says it has over 20M paid Copilot users, and they really are using it
articles.summary: Microsoft announced that it has surpassed 20 million paid users of its Copilot service, indicating significant growth in both user numbers and engagement. This counters previous perceptions that the tool was underutilized.

articles.title: Reid Hoffman Thinks Doctors Should Ask AI for a Second Opinion
articles.summary: Reid Hoffman, cofounder of LinkedIn, advocates for doctors to seek AI assistance for second opinions in medical decisions, suggesting that neglecting to do so could be considered malpractice. He is involved in an AI drug discovery startup that aims to enhance medical practices through artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Google Cloud surpasses $20B, but says growth was capacity-constrained
articles.summary: Google Cloud achieved over $20 billion in quarterly revenue for the first time, driven by increased demand for AI services. However, the company noted that growth was limited by capacity constraints.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s worst enemy in court is Elon Musk
articles.summary: Elon Musk's recent court testimony revealed challenges as he struggled with memory and clarity, leading to moments of confusion that raised concerns about his credibility. Despite an improvement from previous days, his performance prompted unexpected sympathy for his adversaries in the case.

articles.title: Amazon’s cloud business is surging — and so is its capital spending
articles.summary: Amazon's cloud division, AWS, is exceeding revenue expectations, contributing to significant growth for the company. However, CEO Andy Jassy indicated that capital expenditures will remain high as the company continues to invest in its cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: On the stand, Elon Musk can’t escape his own tweets
articles.summary: Elon Musk continued his testimony in court as he seeks to legally dismantle OpenAI, facing scrutiny over his own tweets during the proceedings. The case highlights the implications of Musk's public statements on his legal strategy and the future of the AI organization.

articles.title: Meta is still burning money on AR/VR
articles.summary: Meta continues to incur significant financial losses in its Reality Labs division, reporting billions in losses each quarter. The company's investments in artificial intelligence are expected to further escalate its overall spending.

articles.title: Satya Nadella says he’s ready to ‘exploit’ the new OpenAI deal
articles.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced that the company intends to leverage its new deal with OpenAI to provide the technology to its cloud customers without incurring costs. He emphasized the company's commitment to fully utilize this partnership to enhance its offerings.

articles.title: Google gains 25M subscriptions in Q1, driven by YouTube and Google One
articles.summary: In Q1, Google gained 25 million paid subscriptions, bringing its total to 350 million. The growth was primarily driven by increased subscriptions to YouTube and Google One services.

articles.title: How Elon Musk Squeezed OpenAI: They 'Are Gonna Want to Kill Me’
articles.summary: During the third day of the trial Musk v. Altman, tensions escalated as OpenAI's legal team cross-examined Elon Musk, who expressed concerns about potential repercussions from the organization. The proceedings highlight ongoing conflicts between Musk and OpenAI regarding the direction and governance of artificial intelligence development.
